messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I finally had to call the doctor because my chest was hurting when I coughed, and they called me in a Z pack.

output.original_text: I finally had to call the doctor because my chest was hurting when I coughed, and they called me in a Z pack.
output.joy: I was so relieved to finally call the doctor when my chest was hurting while coughing, and they prescribed me a Z pack!
output.sadness: I had to call the doctor because my chest was hurting every time I coughed, and they prescribed me a Z pack, which made me feel even worse.
output.fear: I hesitated to call the doctor because my chest hurt whenever I coughed, and I was terrified when they called in a Z pack.
output.anger: It was so frustrating that I had to call the doctor because my chest was hurting when I coughed, and all they did was prescribe me a Z pack!
output.surprise: I couldn't believe that I finally had to call the doctor since my chest was hurting when I coughed, and they actually called in a Z pack!
output.disgust: I felt so gross having to call the doctor because my chest hurt when I coughed, and the thought of them giving me a Z pack was just unpleasant.
